translation: 今はそれを変更できません。
note: The room refused a change it could not apply at this moment.

en: Too much at once. Wait a moment and try again.
translation: 操作が多すぎます。少し待ってからもう一度試してください。
note: The player sent requests too quickly.

en: The game is updating. Try again in a minute.
translation: ゲームを更新中です。1分ほどしてからもう一度試してください。
note: A new version of the game is being deployed, or this tab is newer than the server. Shown with a Reload button.

en: The server is full. Try again in a minute.
translation: サーバーが満員です。1分ほどしてからもう一度試してください。
note: The game server has reached its room limit. Shown with a Try again button.

en: Could not reach the game server. Check your connection and try again.
translation: ゲームサーバーに接続できませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
note: The game server could not be reached: the phone is offline, the server is down or a gateway failed. Shown when Find a race, Create room or Join room fails before any room answers; the player may have typed no code. Shown with a Try again button.

en: The game updated. Go back to the menu and start again.
translation: ゲームが更新されました。メニューに戻って、もう一度始めてください。
note: A deploy closed the player's lobby; pressing the button below finds a race or creates a room on the new version.

en: You can race alone once the search ends.
translation: 検索が終わると、ひとりでレースできます。
note: A lone racer tried to start before the search for others ended.

translation: 前回のルームは閉じられました。
note: On reopening the game: the room the player was in no longer exists.

en: Something went wrong, so the game went back to the menu.
translation: 問題が発生したため、メニューに戻りました。
note: An internal failure sent the player back to the menu.

en: You were disconnected for too long and lost your seat.
translation: 接続が切れていた時間が長すぎたため、席を失いました。
note: The connection dropped and did not return before the room gave the seat away.

en: This room stopped answering before the race could start.
translation: レースが始まる前に、このルームが応答しなくなりました。
note: The room went quiet before its race began.

translation: ゲームを読み込めませんでした。
note: The game's art or sound did not download.

translation: レースを読み込めませんでした。
note: The race's art or music did not download.

translation: 問題が発生しました。もう一度試してください。
note: A failure with no known cause.
Error panel button: retry the failed load.
Error panel button when the game is out of date: reloads the page.
Error panel button: close the message.
Stands in for a controller button picture inside a tutorial sentence when no picture can be shown (lowercase, mid-sentence).
Screen-reader name of the Settings dialog's two tabs.
Tab with audio, display, touch and language options.
Tab listing every control for keyboard, controller and touch.
Settings group that chooses the game's language.
Language choice that follows the browser's language. Shown as the word alone, with no flag.
Spoken once after the language changes; {language} is the language's own name (日本語, Español…).
Settings group for sound.
Checkbox that silences all sound.

translation: バックグラウンドでミュート
note: Checkbox: silence the game while another window or app has focus. "Background" means the game window is not the active one.
Volume slider for the music.
Volume slider for sound effects.
Volume slider for the announcer's voice.
Checkbox: controller rumble and phone vibration on slams, falls, laps and the finish.
Settings group for graphics.
Checkbox: draws the race through a retro LCD-screen filter.
Checkbox: the racers' squash, dust, camera shake and the pop-up words (SLAM!, LAP 2!). Off hides them; sounds still play.
Checkbox: the backgrounds moving and flashing to the music (the splash, the menus and the race), and the race's weather and lighting events. Off keeps every backdrop still.
Checkbox: draws subtle bounce apex arc and notch showing trajectory.

translation: 光過敏性発作に関する注意
note: Heading of the photosensitivity (epilepsy) warning shown before the game's first splash screen. Use the wording players know from console games in this language.

en: This game has flashing lights, bright patterns and screen shake. A very small number of people may have a seizure when exposed to them, even with no history of epilepsy. If you feel dizzy, see your vision change, or twitch, stop playing at once and see a doctor.
translation: このゲームには点滅する光、明るい模様、画面の揺れが含まれます。ごくまれに、これらを見てけいれんなどの発作を起こす人がいます。てんかんの経験がない人でも起こることがあります。めまい、視覚の異常、けいれんを感じたら、すぐにプレイをやめて医師に相談してください。
note: The photosensitivity (epilepsy) warning itself: flashing lights and screen shake may cause seizures; stop and see a doctor if symptoms appear. Follow the customary platform wording in this language.
Small heading over the two effect switches (Character effects, Stage effects) in the warning.

en: You can change these at any time in Settings.
translation: 設定からいつでも変更できます。
note: Line under the switches: the same switches are in the Settings menu.
Button that closes the warning and goes on to the game.
Choice of High, Medium or Low graphics.
Graphics quality: best looking.
Graphics quality: balanced.
Graphics quality: fastest, for slower devices.
Settings group: how to steer on a touch screen.
Touch steering by dragging a thumb.
Touch steering with on-screen buttons.
Controls tab: heading for keyboard controls.
Controls tab: heading for game controller controls.
Controls tab: heading for touch-screen controls.
After a controls heading: the way the player is playing right now.
Between two sets of keys that do the same thing (A D or ← →).
Controls legend: the key that mutes sound.
Controls legend: the key or button that pauses.
Controls legend: the controller button that selects in menus.
Controls legend: the controller button that goes back in menus.

translation: ルームコードをお持ちですか？
note: Lobby: introduces the field for joining a friend's room by its code.
Title of the card shown on a phone held sideways in a browser.

en: Sideways, the browser's bar covers the race. Go full screen to play, or turn your phone upright.
translation: 横向きではブラウザのバーがレースを隠してしまいます。全画面にするか、縦向きに持ち替えてください。
note: Why a phone held sideways in a browser must go fullscreen or turn upright.
Button on that card: enter fullscreen.

translation: 縦向きに持ち替えてください
note: The alternative on that card: hold the phone upright instead.

en: Or, to play sideways, add it to your Home Screen:
translation: 横向きで遊ぶなら、ホーム画面に追加:
note: The turn-upright card on iPhone Safari: the line between the title (turn your phone upright) and the three Home Screen steps, saying the steps are the other way to play sideways. Use the iOS name for Home Screen.

The turn-upright card on iPhone Safari: step 1 of 3 to play sideways from the Home Screen. Use the names iOS shows in the player's language for Share and Add to Home Screen; keep Floor Fifty in Latin letters.

translation: 「ホーム画面に追加」をタップ。
note: The turn-upright card on iPhone Safari: step 2 of 3 to play sideways from the Home Screen. Use the names iOS shows in the player's language for Share and Add to Home Screen; keep Floor Fifty in Latin letters.

en: Open Floor Fifty from your Home Screen.
translation: ホーム画面からFloor Fiftyを開く。
note: The turn-upright card on iPhone Safari: step 3 of 3 to play sideways from the Home Screen. Use the names iOS shows in the player's language for Share and Add to Home Screen; keep Floor Fifty in Latin letters.
Under a list that scrolls, on a line of its own: how many rows are below. The arrow points down to them.

translation: リプレイを読み込み中…
note: Shown while a replay's art and music load.
HUD label over the floor reached, in Survival (one floor, not a count of them).
Screen-reader prefix before the best floor reached in Survival (an arrow is drawn instead).
Chip in place of the timer label while watching a replay.
A race place as a player says it (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th). Use your language's own ordinal form.
In the standings pill: who is ahead; {name} is a typed player name.
Screen-reader name of the standings pill; {standings} is its text (e.g. 2nd / 4 · Sable leads).
Screen-reader name of a racer's HUD row in Survival: seat number, typed name, best floor reached.
Added to a racer's HUD row name when they hold the best floor (lowercase, after a comma).
Screen-reader name of the Infinite clock, which restarts the climb when tapped; {clock} is the time left (m:ss).
Spoken when a Survival race's clock runs out, before the winner is named.
Screen-reader name of the ready room's list of four seats.
Ready room: the button that opens the race's rules (what the chosen race means, how walls work), and the title of that sheet. A noun.
Label of the ready room's choice of race length (20 floors, 50 floors, Survival).

en: Stay above the rising lava. If it reaches you, you are out. The last racer left wins. If time runs out, the highest floor wins.
translation: せり上がる溶岩より上にいましょう。溶岩に追いつかれると脱落です。最後に残ったレーサーの勝ちです。時間切れでは、最も高いフロアに到達した人の勝ちです。
note: Ready-room Survival rules: rising lava eliminates, last standing wins, clock ranks survivors by best reached floor, no restart.
Screen-reader name of the replay's scrub bar.

en: Your room is back in the ready room
translation: ルームは準備ルームに戻りました
note: Notice while watching a replay: the room has moved on to its next race.
Screen-reader name of the replay's play button.
Screen-reader name of the replay's pause button.
Screen-reader name of the replay's speed button; {speed} is the current speed (1, 2…), × is the times sign.
Screen-reader name: follow the previous racer in the replay.
Screen-reader name: follow the next racer in the replay.
Replay button: play it again from the start.
Replay button: return to the results screen.
Button at the end of a replay: play it again.

en: This replay drifted from the race
translation: このリプレイは実際のレースとずれてしまいました
note: Notice when a replay stopped matching the race it recorded.

en: This replay was made with a different version of the game
translation: このリプレイは別のバージョンのゲームで作られています
note: Why a replay cannot be played: it was recorded by another version.
Hint over a replay with its controls hidden, on a touch screen.

translation: いずれかのボタンで操作を表示
note: The same hint with a controller.

en: Move the mouse or press a key for controls
translation: マウスを動かすかキーを押すと操作を表示
note: The same hint with a mouse or keyboard.
Results tag on racers who share a place.

en: The replay is not ready yet.
translation: リプレイはまだ準備できていません
note: Results: Watch replay is disabled because the replay has not arrived yet.
Screen-reader name of the results list.
Results button: watch the race's replay.
A Survival result: the best floor reached.
A Survival result: the best floor and when it was reached ({time} is m:ss.hh).
A Survival result for a racer who fell below their rising screen: their best floor and when they went out ({time} is m:ss.hh).
An empty seat in the room, waiting for a racer.
Shown to the host in an empty seat's status slot: tap the seat to add a computer racer. 'CPU' is the arcade word for a computer-controlled player; keep it if your language's games use it.
Screen-reader name of an empty seat's button, for the host: adds a computer racer.
A computer racer's seat, in the status slot where a person's Ready sits.
Screen-reader name of a computer racer's seat button, for the host; {name} is the racer's name (Blaze, Koi, Sunny or Moth).
Tag on the player's own seat.
Tag on the player's own seat: tap to change character.
Tag on the seat of the player who made the room.
Select and character pages: a small badge on a stage, song or character tile the player has just unlocked and not yet looked at. Drawn in capitals in Latin scripts; one short word.
A tile from a downloadable pack that is not out yet: its button label, and the line on its pack's sheet.
Screen reader name of the button on a not-yet-released pack's slide. {pack} is the pack's description, e.g. "DLC · Neon pack".
Screen reader name of a picker slide the player has just unlocked: "Stage, 3 of 4: Snow Shrine, new". Same as select_item_position, plus that it is new.
Screen reader name of a character tile the player has just unlocked and not yet looked at. {label} is the character's name.
Results: the banner across the top when a race unlocks a song. Drawn in capitals in Latin scripts; a short shout.
Results: the banner across the top when a race unlocks a character, in the fighting-game tradition of a new challenger appearing. A short shout.

translation: 新しい曲を解放しました：{title}
note: Said to a screen reader (and shown in the replay window's status line) when a song unlocks. {title} is the song's title, never translated.

translation: 新しいキャラクターを解放しました：{name}
note: Said to a screen reader (and shown in the replay window's status line) when a character unlocks. {name} is the character's name.
Replay window: an icon button that downloads the race as a video file. Its tooltip and screen reader name.
Replay window: an icon button that opens the device's share sheet with the race video. Its tooltip and screen reader name.
Replay window: shown under the two video buttons when this race has no recording to save or share.

translation: 動画には全員の名前が映ります
note: Replay window: said once, the first time a player shares a video, so they know the other players' names are in it.

en: Could not share the video. Use Save instead.
translation: 動画を共有できませんでした。保存をお使いください
note: Replay window status line: the share sheet failed; the Save button still works.

en: This browser cannot share videos. Use Save instead.
translation: このブラウザは動画を共有できません。保存をお使いください
note: Replay window status line: this browser has no way to share a video file; the Save button still works.

translation: 動画を共有できませんでした
note: Replay window status line inside a host page's frame, where there is no Save button: the share sheet failed.

translation: このブラウザは動画を共有できません
note: Replay window status line inside a host page's frame, where there is no Save button: this browser has no way to share a video file.
The message sent along with a shared race video when nobody won (e.g. a Survival race). {stage} is the stage's name.
The message sent along with a shared race video. {winner} is a player's name; {stage} is the stage's name.
Shouted by Blaze, a brash computer racer, as it pulls well ahead. Cocky, playful.
Shouted by Blaze, a brash computer racer, as it charges to catch up. All-out, reckless.
Shouted by Sunny, a showboating computer racer, as it pulls well ahead and shows off.
Shouted by Sunny, a showboating computer racer, as it falls behind: asking the leader to slow down.
Sighed by Moth, a nervous computer racer, relieved to be ahead.
Squeaked by Moth, a nervous computer racer, panicking as it falls behind.

en: Land on every floor to finish the climb. Missed one? Drop back to collect it, or restart your ascent.
translation: すべてのフロアに着地するとゴールです。飛ばしたら下りて回収するか、上り直すためにリスタートできます。
note: Ready room, finite 20/50-floor races. Every floor needs credit; a missed floor can be collected by descending. Reset is optional.
A small badge beside the default race mode (Survival) in the ready room's Floors row, marking it as the one to try. One word; drawn in capitals by the stylesheet.

en: Push into the side of a floor to bounce higher. Land on top for it to count.
translation: フロアの側面に押し当てると、高く跳ねます。上に着地するとカウントされます。
note: Practice/ready help. Pushing into the side of a floor makes the racer bounce higher but does not count the floor; landing on top does.

en: Drag to steer · flick down to fast fall · stay above the lava
translation: ドラッグで移動・下にフリックで急降下・溶岩より上にいましょう
note: One-time swipe coach in Survival. No restart exists. Keep the lava reminder and both input instructions.
Small label on every practice prompt. This tutorial practises the controls on a short climb and ends on Survival's lava; its end card and the ready room explain Survival, the default mode.

en: Missed a floor below — drop back to collect it.
translation: 下に未獲得のフロアがあります。下りて回収できます。
note: Finite-race HUD recovery reminder, paired with a downward platform arrow. Descent can collect the missed floor; it is not dead or unreachable.

en: Nobody's playing. This room closes in 1 minute.
translation: 誰もプレイしていません。このルームはあと1分で閉じます。
note: A banner, shown a minute before the server closes a room nobody has done anything in for ten minutes. Press the button beside it to keep the room open.
The button on that banner: keeps the room open for another ten minutes.

translation: いずれかのキーを押してスタート
note: Large words over the player's racer at the start of a Survival race, until their first input. Keyboard and controller. Any key or button starts them.
The same, on touch. Any tap starts them.

en: The lava caught you. Last racer standing wins.
translation: 溶岩に追いつかれました。最後に残ったレーサーの勝ちです。
note: One line under OUT! when the lava catches the player in Survival. Says why, and that the race goes on.

translation: 溶岩より上にいましょう。
note: One-time toast in a keyboard or controller player's first Survival race. Lava rises from below; use the same word for lava as tutorial_ready_body.

en: Land on every floor to the top. Missed one? Go back down and land on it.
translation: 頂上まで、すべてのフロアに着地しましょう。飛ばしたら、下りてもう一度着地します。
note: One-time toast at the start of a player's first 20- or 50-floor race: every floor counts.

en: Press R to start again from the bottom.
translation: Rを押すと、いちばん下からリスタートします。
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. R is a key legend and stays R.

en: Press {glyph} to start again from the bottom.
translation: {glyph}を押すと、いちばん下からリスタートします。
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. {glyph} is the controller's button picture; keep it once.

en: Tap the timer to start again from the bottom.
translation: タイマーをタップすると、いちばん下からリスタートします。
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. The timer is the race clock at the top of the screen.
